title: shop-1
description: A shop server. ufw is on with default deny, and Docker runs the database, the cache and an admin page next to it.

title: shop-1, fixed
description: The same server after the fix. Docker publishes its three ports on this machine only, and the ufw rule for a port nothing listens on is gone.

title: edge-1
description: A gateway with no firewall tool. Its rules are written in nftables by hand: a WireGuard tunnel, a LAN behind it, and two ports passed on to machines inside.

title: shop-1, no root
description: The shop server read without sudo. The kernel hands its packet rules to root only, so the report says what it could not read and decides nothing.
